guide.hero.title: Understand Go Drive in a few simple steps
guide.hero.title_html: Understand Go Drive ina few simple steps
guide.hero.lead: Everything happens inside the mobile app — fast, clear and secure.
guide.clients.sub: Three steps to order and track live.
guide.clients.s1.title: Download the app
guide.clients.s1.text: Download Go Drive from the home page or via the QR code.
guide.clients.s2.title: Place an order
guide.clients.s2.text: Create or use your customer account to request a delivery, an ambulance or roadside help.
guide.clients.s3.title: Track and share
guide.clients.s3.text: Follow your order in real time and share the QR code with the recipient.
guide.drivers.sub: Manage your trips straight from the app.
guide.drivers.s1.title: Activate your profile
guide.drivers.s1.text: Install the app and activate your driver account.
guide.drivers.s2.title: Accept trips
guide.drivers.s2.text: Browse available requests and accept nearby missions.
guide.drivers.s3.title: Update the delivery
guide.drivers.s3.text: Update the status and track deliveries in real time.
guide.trust.v1.title: Live tracking
guide.trust.v1.text: Driver location and statuses updated at every step.
guide.trust.v2.title: Secure QR code
guide.trust.v2.text: A unique code per order, shared between customer and driver.
guide.trust.v3.title: Notifications at every step
guide.trust.v3.text: A clear alert at every update of your order.
